events_seen: FREE AGENT ADD (Nov 22 (today)): Adam added Phil Mafah (RB, NYG) (dropped Charlie Kolar (TE, LAC)).
FREE AGENT ADD (Nov 22 (today)): Mitchum added Jaydn Ott (RB, KC) (dropped Sean Tucker (RB, TB)).
FREE AGENT ADD (Nov 22 (today)): Drew added Josh Johnson (QB, ARI) (dropped Tyler Goodson (RB, DAL)).
CUT (Nov 20 (2 days ago)): Mitchum released Demarcus Robinson (WR, SF).
CUT (Nov 19 (3 days ago)): Fronge released Brevyn Spann-Ford (TE, DAL).
WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 18 (4 days ago)): Adam added Xavier Restrepo (WR, TEN) (dropped Stetson Bennett IV (QB, LAR)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 18 (4 days ago)): Ryan added Zonovan Knight (RB, ARI) for $1 FAAB (dropped Michael Carter (RB, TEN)).
CUT (Nov 18 (4 days ago)): Mitchum released Dameon Pierce (RB, FA).

WEEK 10 RESULTS: Corbishley def. Wingard, 141.2-105.7; Adam def. Fronge, 162.0-125.3; Mitchum def. Drew, 134.0-69.0 (BLOWOUT); Jake def. Charles, 180.5-176.4 (NAIL-BITER); Kevin def. Ryan, 137.6-133.8 (NAIL-BITER); Shaq def. Brent, 107.0-76.5

tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: FINAL: Charles def. Shaq 165.8-61.5. Crownline was trailing Monarch early and then absolutely obliterated them. 16-5 for Charles. The championship-or-bust clock is ticking louder.

tweets.name: Dina Ravioli
tweets.text: Also going final: Ryan def. Brent 130.9-52.2. Aegis gets back to .500 at 10-11. Obsidian drops to 10-11 as well. The TE premium did not show up for Brent today and that is a sentence Matteo has been waiting to type for nine weeks.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: DREW. ZERO. AND TWENTY. ATLAS REBUILD WORKS IS ZERO AND TWENTY. I DO NOT HAVE WORDS. I HAVE ONLY THE NUMBER ZERO.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Fronge leads Kevin 82.1-21.2 with time winding down and I need someone to explain to me how Redline sold 2027 first-round capital for a quarterback room that is currently being outscored by a team operating out of Havana.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: I called Kevin the most fragile 13-5 in the league and said the dynasty grade was dead last by twenty-eight points. He is currently losing by sixty to ForgeHammer. The power rankings are not a feelings exercise. They are a document.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Charles goes into week 11 trailing Shaq and finishes with a hundred-point margin. I took Crownline before the first score posted and I am 8-4 on the season, which is the top of this board, and I would like someone to give me a segment where I can explain the difference between a wobble and a collapse because apparently that distinction is lost on this network.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Three teams entered week 11 knotted at 15-5. By Sunday evening, Charles is 16-5, Corbishley and Kevin are still live, and the tiebreaker math is about to become the most important spreadsheet in the league. The Ledger is going to need a second page.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called Corbishley over Adam in this matchup and Corbishley leads 83.3-49.5 going to the finish — the thesis held, the board confirmed it, and I am 7-5 on a season where the variance has not been kind to anyone not named Bo Ruckman.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: The 5-7 record does not reflect how many of those games came down to a single asset outperforming by twelve points in the final hour. I am tracking it. The regression is coming.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Ryan adds Zonovan Knight from Arizona, Drew adds Josh Johnson at quarterback, and Mitchum picks up Jaydn Ott out of Kansas City — all three moves happening on a Sunday when their respective owners are either fighting for playoff position or simply fighting to stay off the exchange's discontinued-listings page.
